evidence.reason: The replay at lines 527–528 reuses the same mutated in-memory `self.queue` and `item` after the injected ledger failure. It never reloads `state/queue.json`, so the test would still pass if harvest’s failed terminal state or the two-job `record['jobs']` update existed only in memory; a fresh tick would then not reproduce the sibling replay path. The fixture should be persisted after adding the sibling, then the queue reloaded and the reloaded item replayed.
